summary: You can now turn GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for repositories on or off with the REST API at the organization and repository levels. This public preview adds a repository_scan setting to the existing AI Scan enablement endpoints.
takeaways: The post Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
Users with write access still run scans on demand, and each scan consumes GitHub Code Security AI credits.
Who can use it Organization owners and security managers can manage the organization setting.
